Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] We followed an identical procedure, introducing PA, NA and PH as the independent variables to predict chronotype both concurrently and prospectively while controlling for pubertal status and gender, to examine the relationship between the tripartite model and chronotype.
Outcome_variable.warning: PH is not a standard SWB component and is not extracted.

lag.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] Next, we investigated the prospective relationship between anxiety and chronotype by including all anxiety subscales from T1 as independent variables to predict chronotype at T2 (18-months post-T1), while controlling for T2 anxiety subscale scores.
